All deliverables are complete in the working directory:

- **`theta_phase_precession.py`** — final jupytext script (verified to run end-to-end without manual intervention, ~90s runtime)
- **`theta_phase_precession.ipynb`** — executed notebook with all outputs, 0 errors
- **6 figures** (`fig1`–`fig6`) — all visually inspected for layout quality
- **`README.md`** — summary of dataset and findings

**Dataset:** DANDI:000044 (Grosmark & Buzsaki), rat CA1 linear-track session, streamed via `remfile` (no full download).

**Key findings:**
- Selected the LFP channel with strongest theta/delta power ratio; PSD shows a clear ~9 Hz peak during running.
- 89 place cells identified by spatial information on outbound runs; population place fields tile the 1.6 m track.
- **Theta entrainment**: 63/89 place cells (71%) show significant Rayleigh phase-locking.
- **Theta phase precession**: of 61 candidate place cells, 28 show a significant negative circular-linear slope (permutation test) versus only 1 positive — a clear population-level replication of the classic O'Keefe & Recce (1993) precession signature.
